items.title: Gujarat Govt: No More Caste Names Or Symbols On Vehicles!
points: Car and motorcycle owners in Gujarat can no longer display caste-identifying words, symbols or signs on their private vehicles.
The Gujarat Ports and Transport Department notified the Gujarat Motor Vehicles (Third Amendment) Rules, 2026, on November 17.
The amendment changes Rule 125(1) of the Gujarat Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, by specifically adding caste signage to an existing provision about advertising devices and figures.
It also inserts Rule 138(3), which prohibits advertising devices, caste signage, figures or writing on private vehicles unless the state government allows them through a general or special order.
The state had published draft changes in June 2026 and invited objections and suggestions for 30 days.
Reports also say the Centre had advised states on caste-based signage and that Uttar Pradesh had earlier introduced a similar change following an Allahabad High Court judgment.
Gujarat's action therefore comes as part of a wider effort to discourage the public display of caste identity on vehicles.

items.title: Farmers suffer during kharif as banks did not achieve targets of agri credit

While weather played truant in their attempts to sustain the momentum of being the top paddy-producing State in the country, banks did not fulfil their targets of agricultural credit during the kharif season.

Kharif production was down by an estimated 16% to 17% due to El Niño-induced monsoon deficit, and there is uncertainty over the extent of the government’s help to farmers who have been advised not to go for water intensive crops like paddy in the rabi.

According to available information, banks had set a target of disbursing ₹58,152 crore under priority sector lending but disbursed only ₹42,885 crore during the first half of the current financial year (April 1 to September 30).

The Defender is one of Land Rover's best-known models, with a design built around an upright stance, high shoulders, squared-off proportions and a distinctive rear-side profile.
